candidates.angle: inversion / already-won: pigeons have had humans serving them for 300 years without ever pitching; the raise exists to keep it that way
candidates.text: For 300 years, humans have built us statues, fed us daily, and cleaned up after us — and we never pitched them once. We're raising our first round to keep it that way.

candidates.angle: surveillance-data startup: pigeons as the original always-on city sensor network, parodying a data-company pitch
candidates.text: We watch every crumb dropped in this city from above, in real time. Google knows what you search. We know what you eat, where you sit, and when you look up.

candidates.angle: hostile acquisition: pigeons acquiring the seagulls for the beachfront, merger kicker about boardwalk chips
candidates.text: We're acquiring the seagulls. They hold the beachfront, we hold the numbers — and after the merger, every chip on every boardwalk is ours.
